description: Store items end to end. The blob is an entry container (§5.2) sealed at `epoch` with the item id as its entry id; its content key and a random metadata key are wrapped under the store key of that epoch (105 bytes), and the metadata record (2048 bytes, sealed 2089) under the metadata key. A reader holds only the store key: it unwraps both keys and opens the container with the content key. `meta` is what the writer had; `meta_decoded` is what a reader gets back, after the content-type fallback and the filename cut.

vectors.name: item-text
vectors.description: a short text saved at epoch 1, with a name and nothing else

vectors.name: item-file-tags
vectors.description: a file saved at epoch 3, with a non-ASCII filename, a description and three tags

vectors.name: item-edited
vectors.description: metadata at revision 4: an edit seals a new record under the same metadata key

vectors.name: item-limits
vectors.description: every user-typed field at its limit; a content type over 128 bytes falls back and a filename over 255 bytes is cut
